messages:
jess: Quick thread — we need a decision on the JS SDK publishing strategy that won't break edge runtimes.

sam: +1, what's the specific concern?

jess: Two things: (1) conditional exports + dual CJS/ESM builds vs single ESM with lightweight CJS stub; (2) Types entrypoints for TS consumers and typings on edge bundlers (esbuild/webpack)...

maria: Edge runtimes (Vercel/Cloudflare Workers) choke on packages that include Node builtins or CJS at top-level. If we ship a full CJS main, Next.js edge SSR auto-bundlers can pull it and fail.

noah: Can we do "exports" field that points to "./dist/esm/index.js" for "import" and "./dist/cjs/index.js" for "require" + "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts" ? That's the usual pattern.

sam: That works but some bundlers still resolve "require" at build-time for edge bundles. We should consider "exports" with conditional loading and a "node" vs "default" condition. Example:
```json
"exports": {
  "import": "./esm/index.js",
  "require": "./cjs/index.js",
  "edge": "./edge/index.mjs",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts"
}
```

jess: Edge condition is not standard yet. Vercel/Cloudflare won't consult custom keys. But we can use "browser" or "module" fields maybe.

maria: Alternative: ship a tiny edge-compatible ESM entry at "./dist/edge.mjs" and point "module" at it. Keep CJS in "main" for node consumers.

noah: Types: keep a single d.ts that exports same surface. Avoid conditional types fields; tsc uses "types" or "typesVersions". Might need "typesVersions" for old TS paths.

sam: Also, auth + retry behavior: edge SDKs can't access long-lived token refreshers that use setTimeout or background threads. Our auth layer needs an explicit async refresh hook that runs per-request or uses a cache with short TTL.

jess: Right — current SDK automatically refreshes tokens in background for node but edge breaks. Proposal: add optional "authFetcher" option where runtime provides async getToken() and optional onRefresh hooks. Default for node: internal refresher. Default for edge: simple per-request fetch with shared in-memory cache.

maria: Also streaming + retry: streaming responses can't be retried after partial body consumed. We should document semantics and provide opt-in buffered retry for non-edge heavy workloads.

sam: We should add example apps: next-edge-example and next-node-example showing package.json config (exports + module + main + types) and edge-specific auth adapter.

jess: Action items: @sam draft package.json export proposal + edge.mjs stub; @maria write auth adapter interface and sample; @noah add types packaging notes. I'll collect into a RFC doc.

dev-bot: Created rfc/edge-dual-pkg-auth.md #1234

noah: timeline? ideally before next minor SDK release.

sam: I'll have a draft by EOD tomorrow.

jess: sweet, thanks :thumbsup:
